_comment: Which features may import which. This file is the single source for feature-to-feature dependencies: an import not listed here fails `npm run arch:check` (and the test), and so does a listed dependency nothing uses. Lower features first. `mutual` lists the one pair that may depend on each other, and why.

mutual.reason: create records a finished card into history and shows history-based progress; history re-opens a card in the create flow and reads template data. Through application hooks and domain only.
